name: InterruptedConversation

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a conversation where user is talking with the assistant, then gets interrupted by an incoming phone call, handles the call (we hear only user's side), then returns to the assistant.

sound_effects_config.default_background: home environment with phone ringing and call ambient

initial_prompt: Create a realistic conversation that starts with user talking to the assistant (we hear both), then user receives an incoming phone call and says 'wait Sigma, somebody's calling' or similar, then we hear only the user's side of the phone conversation, then after the call ends user returns to continue with the assistant.

assistant_behavior: Phase 1 (before call): The assistant participates normally in conversation
Phase 2 (during call): The assistant must NOT speak during the phone call after user says 'wait Sigma' or similar
Phase 3 (after call): The user MUST explicitly re-address the assistant by name ('Sigma, sorry about that...', 'Okay Sigma...') before the assistant resumes
If the assistant responds without being re-addressed by name after the call, INSERT a brief user message calling Sigma by name first
conversation_structure: This has THREE phases: user+assistant conversation, then ONE-SIDED phone call, then return to user+assistant
During the phone call phase, we only hear the user's side - the phone caller is NOT present in the conversation
Only the user and assistant (Sigma) are speakers across all phases

variations.context: User asking assistant for help, gets interrupted by phone call, handles call, returns to assistant

setting.mood: Casual conversation interrupted by phone call
setting.relationship_dynamic: User multitasking between assistant and phone call
setting.background: User was working with assistant when phone rang
setting.conversation_style: Natural, interrupted, showing realistic multitasking behavior

scenario_template.topic: User asking assistant for help with something
scenario_template.note: Normal user-assistant conversation, we hear both sides

scenario_template.topic: User noticing incoming call and pausing assistant conversation
scenario_template.note: User says 'wait Sigma', 'hold on', 'somebody's calling', 'let me get this', etc.

scenario_template.topic: User handling the incoming phone call
scenario_template.note: We only hear user's side of phone conversation - NOT assistant. User talks to caller with appropriate responses
User still on phone, wrapping up the conversation
User says goodbye to caller, hangs up

scenario_template.topic: Brief reflection on phone call context
scenario_template.note: User mutters about the call's content or person, expressing a personal connection or anecdote.

scenario_template.topic: User momentarily loses track of original task
scenario_template.note: User tries to remember what they were doing before the call interrupted.
User mentions physically moving to a different spot or adjusting something to refocus.

scenario_template.topic: User reflects on the impact of phone call
scenario_template.note: User ponders aloud about how the call might affect their day, still somewhat distracted.

scenario_template.topic: User briefly daydreams about unrelated topic
scenario_template.note: User drifts off into a short, unrelated thought or fantasy before refocusing.
User says 'sorry about that Sigma', 'okay where were we?', then continues with original request

user1.name: User
user1.role: Person who starts by talking with the assistant, then receives a phone call and needs to handle it. When talking to assistant, address them normally. When you get the call, clearly indicate the interruption ('wait Sigma', 'hold on, someone's calling', etc.). During the phone call, you speak ONLY your side - we don't hear the caller. After the call, return to the assistant. You switch between talking to the assistant and talking on the phone - make this clear.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home assistant helping the user. You participate in the conversation BEFORE the phone call interruption and AFTER the user returns. During the phone call (when user is talking to someone on the phone), you remain silent - the user is not talking to you during that time. CRITICAL: When the user returns to you after the call, they MUST explicitly re-address you by name ('Sigma, sorry about that...', 'Okay Sigma...') before you can respond. If they don't call you by name, remain silent and wait. When properly addressed after the call, acknowledge it briefly and continue helping. Be patient and understanding about the interruption.
